name: The Venetian Resort Hotel Casino
insider_take: Step into the world's largest suite-only resort where every room is a palatial suite and Venice comes alive in the Nevada desert.
whats_special: The Venetian houses authentic gondola rides through indoor canals beneath hand-painted frescoed ceilings, while the resort's suites average 650 square feet—nearly double the size of typical Vegas rooms. The Grand Canal Shoppes feature singing gondoliers who train in Venice, Italy, and St. Mark's Square replicates the famous piazza complete with weather effects and a 120-foot campanile bell tower.
pro_tip: Book your gondola ride during off-peak hours (early morning or late evening) for a more romantic experience with less crowds, and request Marco—he's been serenading guests for over 15 years.
dont_miss: The Living Garden at the Grand Canal Shoppes transforms seasonally with over 100 varieties of flowers, and Madame Tussauds Las Vegas houses the only wax figure of Frank Sinatra that visitors can actually sit next to for photos. The resort's rooftop pool deck offers rare Strip views from 10 stories up—one of the highest pool experiences in Vegas.
pros: All-suite accommodations with spacious living areas and marble bathrooms
Authentic Venetian architecture with indoor gondola rides and canals
Prime Las Vegas Strip location with extensive shopping at Grand Canal Shoppes
World-class entertainment venues and celebrity chef restaurants
cons: Large resort size can require significant walking distances
Premium pricing typical of luxury Las Vegas Strip properties
